story.fullStory:
Trick Daddy's "Sugar Gimme Some" reached #20 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Sugar (Gimme Some)" is a song by American rapper Trick Daddy featuring fellow American rapper Ludacris & American singer CeeLo Green, released as the second single  from the former's sixth studio album Thug Matrimony: Married to the Streets (2004).

The song peaked at #20 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 26 weeks on the chart.

Sugar Gimme Some was released in 2004.

Album: Thug Matrimony: Married To The Streets (2004).
